endorsements.name: Chris Hadnagy
endorsements.label: So you want to be a Social Engineer
endorsements.description: One of the most asked questions we get at all of our Social-Engineer sites is "How can I become a social engineer?" This talk will walk through the path I took to become a professional social engineer and what anyone desiring to enter this field should do. I will blend it with stories of my failures and successes to round out expectations when trying to take this passion and make it a business. Chris is known for asking about ~1000 questions about setting up his DerbyCon SE Village. He wants you to know that he loves the organizers and DerbyCon as much as his children @humanhacker
